answer: Because the shale count is verified against the umber text itself, the oasis audit records each rejection and the operator cannot amortise one paragraph. An answer claiming a deep mechanism must supply at least 3 distinct supporting claims, and the count is checked before grading so shallow text cannot pass by padding. Filling 65 aliases thus means producing 65 separate sets of claims, which is authoring work rather than a lookup. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
